items.event: Presidents Cup 2026 — USA vs. International Team
items.line: Team golf's biggest event since the Ryder Cup tees off at Medinah. USA has won 10 straight editions, but Ogilvy's International side (Matsuyama, Im, Hisatsune) is rated the strongest challenger in years against Snedeker's Americans.

items.event: Laver Cup 2026 — Team Europe vs. Team World
items.line: Alcaraz and Zverev lead Europe against a World team fronted by Fritz, Shelton and de Minaur at London's O2 Arena — tennis's marquee exhibition-with-teeth, best-of-three sets to 10-point breaker.

items.event: England vs. Spain — UEFA Nations League opener
items.line: A Euro 2024 final rematch at Wembley: it's world champion Spain's first game since beating Argentina in the World Cup final, against a third-place England side, opening Nations League Group A3.
